notes: Introduces a cohesive desktop UI foundation for tabs, fields, buttons, choices, sliders, disclosures, and context menus.
Adds system Open actions and QR Code sharing with a separate resizable viewer for eligible clipboard content.
Improves repeated Agent activity with aligned ×N watermarks, 99+ capping, and unread-aware color.
Makes Prompt, Skill, and MCP synchronization safer with duplicate detection, atomic writes, read-back verification, and no usage-only rewrites.
Keeps Intel macOS and Windows packages marked as beta.
